camel_example: aliyun hbr CheckRole --region cn-hangzhou --CheckRoleType OssRole --CrossAccountUserId 1589754625 --CrossAccountRoleName BackupRole
description_en: Checks whether the user has permissions to access the current resource or page
description_zh: 用于检查用户是否有权限访问当前资源或页面
kebab_example: aliyun hbr check-role --check-role-type OssRole --cross-account-user-id 1589754625 --cross-account-role-name BackupRole --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckRole

parameters.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:
EcsRole: ECS resource access permissions.
CsgRole: Cloud Storage Gateway backup permissions.
NasRole: NAS backup permissions.
OssRole: OSS backup permissions.
UdmRole: ECS instance backup permissions.
VMwareLocalRole: on-premises VMware virtual machine backup permissions.
VMwareCloudRole: cloud VMware virtual machine backup permissions.
EcsBackupRole: ECS backup permissions.
OtsRole: OTS backup permissions.
CrossAccountRole: cross-account backup permissions
parameters.help_zh:
角色类型。支持：
EcsRole：ECS资源访问权限
CsgRole：云存储网关备份权限
NasRole：NAS备份权限
OssRole：OSS备份权限
UdmRole：ECS整机备份权限
VMwareLocalRole：本地VMWARE虚拟机备份权限
VMwareCloudRole：云上VMWARE虚拟机备份全新啊
EcsBackupRole：ECS备份权限
OtsRole：OTS备份权限
CrossAccountRole：跨账号备份权限
parameters.name: check_role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account for cross-account backups managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the role created in the RAM of the source account for cross-account backups managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name
